title: Deployment guardrails: SDK helpers, rollback webhooks, and idempotent rollout creation
creator: Ava Nguyen
description: Define API and SDK-level guardrails for canary rollouts, A/B tests, shadow traffic, and automated rollback. Goal is to provide idempotent rollout creation, client helpers for safe traffic changes, webhook signals for auto-rollback, and narrowly scoped RBAC so teams can run production rollouts confidently.
acceptance_criteria: API supports idempotent rollout creation via a client_provided_token and returns consistent status on retries
SDKs (JS/Python) expose createRollout, updateTrafficSplit, and triggerRollback helpers with builtin exponential backoff and clear error types
Auto-rollback events emit signed webhooks with machine-readable reason codes and links to SLI dashboards
RBAC scopes rollout.create, rollout.update, rollout.rollback must be enforced and visible in audit logs
E2E staging tests validate canary -> auto-rollback when error-rate or latency SLOs breach thresholds
